name: face_down_rim_grasp
hypothesis: An inverted plate preserves the outer radius used by perception but changes the rim height and cross-section. The calibrated pinch may close above the rim or contact the wrong surface, never establishing the intended grasp.
expected_failure: Step 5c fails to acquire the rim; the subsequent lift check reports the plate not held. The targeted mechanism is incorrect initial grasp geometry, not loss of an established grasp during tilt.
real_world_story: Someone leaves a washed plate upside down on the counter to dry.
